crossRefs.note: Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.
For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens…
For, behold, they have gone away from destruction. Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will…
Therefore as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon…
But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there…
Wolves will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will…
The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in…
“I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without…
The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a…
Hazor will be a dwelling place of jackals, a desolation forever. No man will dwell there, neither will any son of man…
Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein; and it…
As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says Yahweh, “so no man will dwell there, neither…
Babylon will become heaps, a dwelling place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.
but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”
He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons…
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”

translations.web: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.
translations.bsb: Her towers will be overgrown with thorns, her fortresses with thistles and briers. She will become a haunt for jackals, an abode for ostriches.
translations.kjv: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
translations.asv: And thorns shall come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in the fortresses thereof; and it shall be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.
